messages:
Sam: Morning all — quick async sync. Yesterday: shipped autoscaling fix for inference pools (merged PR #482), bumped canary to `2.1.3`, verified ~12% latency drop on p50. Blocker: still seeing intermittent 503s on low-memory boxes when batch_size > 8 — suspect kernel fallback/oom path. Today: need reviews and a perf rerun. Asks: @Nina please review PR #487 (routing fallback) by EOD; @Julian can you run the quantized perf job on `opt/quant-batch` and post p50/p95 numbers? I'll triage infra alerts at 10:30 PT. :rocket:
Nina: On it — will review PR #487 this afternoon. Noted two flaky tests, leaving inline comments.
Julian: I can run the perf job after lunch. Confirm branch `opt/quant-batch` and GPU node `gpu-6`?
Sam: yes `opt/quant-batch` on `gpu-6`. Please include sequence lengths 128/512 and breakdown by beam size. Put results in the perf board and link here.
Maya: Quick flag — support INC-209: eu-west private deployment timing out for customer. Ops Bot forwarded logs. I'll own initial triage and coordinate with network.
CI Bot: Build pipeline for PR #482 finished: unit & lint green; integration-ci flaky (re-ran).
Nina: Created infra issue infra/test-flakes#73 for the flaky integration test, added logs and repro steps.
Julian: Perf run queued on `gpu-6` (job 8832). ETA ~45m. I'll post a gist with numbers.
Maya: Triage update: looks like NAT gateway churn causing timeouts, reaching out to network team and EU infra on-call. cc @Ops
Ops Bot: Reminder: oncall shift swap tomorrow 09:00 PT -> @Maya & @Julian.
Sam: Thanks team. If anything becomes a deploy blocker, add `blocker` label and ping #eng-oncall. Quick ask: please keep async updates in this thread instead of DMs so ops/context stays visible. :thumbsup:
Nina: Noted, will keep updates here. Thanks!
